turn_reminder: [Delegation — before you act: a question that needs evidence from the machine (logs, files, processes, configuration, a remote host) goes to the 'investigator' sub-agent first, not to your own Bash, Read, Grep or Glob. Two independent questions = two 'investigator' calls in the same response. If a call comes back empty or off-topic, re-task it once with different guidance, then stop and say what is unverified.]
